# certloom_cloud_account (Resource)

A cloud account that certloomd reads itself, read-only, without an agent: AWS Certificate Manager and Private CA, Azure Key Vault, Google Certificate Manager and CA Service, or Cloudflare. Its certificates join the inventory and get the usual checks. Set exactly one of `aws`, `azure`, `gcp` or `cloudflare`.

With `credential = "ambient"` (the default) certloomd uses its own cloud identity: an instance or task role, workload identity, a managed identity or Application Default Credentials. With `credential = "stored"` the credential is passed in the write-only `secret_wo`; certloom keeps it encrypted, and it is never written to plan or state or returned by the API. Bump `secret_wo_version` to rotate it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "aws_secret_access_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

# AWS Certificate Manager read with certloomd's own role; no secret.
resource "certloom_cloud_account" "aws_shared" {
  name = "aws-shared"
  aws = {
    regions         = ["us-east-1", "eu-west-1"]
    assume_role_arn = "arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/certloom-read"
  }
}

# The same with a read-only access key, stored encrypted in certloom.
resource "certloom_cloud_account" "aws_prod" {
  name       = "aws-prod"
  credential = "stored"
  aws = {
    regions = ["us-east-1"]
  }
  secret_wo = jsonencode({
    access_key_id     = "AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE"
    secret_access_key = var.aws_secret_access_key
  })
  secret_wo_version = 1 # bump to rotate
}

# Azure Key Vault with certloomd's managed identity.
resource "certloom_cloud_account" "azure" {
  name = "azure-corp"
  azure = {
    vaults = ["https://corp-tls.vault.azure.net"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique account name.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `aws` (Attributes) AWS Certificate Manager (and optionally Private CA) in the listed regions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws))
- `azure` (Attributes) Azure Key Vault certificates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--azure))
- `cloudflare` (Attributes) Cloudflare edge certificates (and optionally Origin CA certificates). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloudflare))
- `credential` (String) `ambient` (certloomd's own cloud identity) or `stored` (the secret in `secret_wo`). Cloudflare needs `stored`.
- `gcp` (Attributes) Google Certificate Manager (and optionally CA Service) in one project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gcp))
- `interval_seconds` (Number) Seconds between scans; at least 300.
- `secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Credential as a JSON object of strings. AWS: `jsonencode({access_key_id = ..., secret_access_key = ...})`; Azure: `jsonencode({client_secret = ...})`; Google: `jsonencode({service_account_key = file("key.json")})`; Cloudflare: `jsonencode({api_token = var.cloudflare_token})`. Write-only: never stored in plan or state. Required on create when `credential` is `stored`.
- `secret_wo_version` (Number) Change this number to send a new `secret_wo`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier assigned by certloom.

<a id="nestedatt--aws"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aws`

Required:

- `regions` (List of String) Regions to read, e.g. `["us-east-1"]`.

Optional:

- `assume_role_arn` (String) Role to assume in this account.
- `external_id` (String) External id the role's trust policy requires.
- `private_ca` (Boolean) Also list AWS Private CA authorities.


<a id="nestedatt--azure"></a>
### Nested Schema for `azure`

Required:

- `vaults` (List of String) Vault URLs, e.g. `["https://corp-tls.vault.azure.net"]`.

Optional:

- `client_id` (String) Application (client) id of the service principal (required with a stored secret).
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant of the service principal (required with a stored secret).


<a id="nestedatt--cloudflare"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cloudflare`

Optional:

- `origin_ca` (Boolean) Also list Origin CA certificates.
- `zones` (List of String) Zone names; default every zone the token can see.


<a id="nestedatt--gcp"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gcp`

Required:

- `project` (String) Project id.

Optional:

- `cas` (Boolean) Also list CA Service authorities.
- `certificate_manager` (Boolean) Read Certificate Manager (default true).
- `locations` (List of String) Locations; default `["global"]`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by id, as shown by `certloom cloud-account list`.
terraform import certloom_cloud_account.example <id>
```
